dedupe_keys.name: code underlying the publication a hybrid spatial temporal deep learning architecture for lane detection

description: TU Delft provides code for a sequence-to-one lane-detection model supporting lane-keeping assistance and lane-departure warnings. A spatial convolutional module extracts image features, a recurrent module combines information across consecutive frames, and an encoder-decoder structure predicts lane markings in the final frame. The native description identifies supervised image segmentation and challenging driving scenes. The custom format field lists Python scripts, text, JPG and AVI components. Coverage: the metadata does not state a complete observation period or geographic evaluation extent. Access: public native metadata identifies the research release. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and current file access remain unknown. Caveats: The source reports performance above other methods, which was not reproduced. Detailed input dimensions, model weights and runtime requirements are unstated. The related training-data link is a Google Drive folder; no files or images were acquired. Its simulation uses concern the specified lane-detection model for driving-assistance systems.
